reports.title: Extra Space Storage Inc. Reports 2026 Third Quarter Results

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: The following table outlines the Company's Core FFO estimates and assumptions for the year ending December 31, 20261.

Current Ranges for 2026 Annual Assumptions | Prior Ranges for 2026 Annual Assumptions | Notes
(October 27, 2026) | (July 28, 2026)
Low | High | Low | High
Core FFO | $8.40 | $8.50 | $8.25 | $8.40
Dilution per share from C of O and value add acquisitions | $0.17 | $0.17 | $0.17 | $0.17
Same-store revenue growth | 2.00% | 2.50% | 1.00% | 2.00% | Same-store pool of 1,869 stores
Same-store expense growth | 0.00% | 0.50% | 1.00% | 2.00% | Same-store pool of 1,869 stores
Same-store NOI growth | 2.50% | 3.50% | 0.50% | 2.50% | Same-store pool of 1,869 stores
Weighted average one-month SOFR | 3.71% | 3.71% | 3.73% | 3.73%
Net tenant reinsurance income | $298,000,000 | $300,000,000 | $294,000,000 | $296,000,000
Management fees and other income | $138,000,000 | $139,000,000 | $139,000,000 | $140,000,000
Interest income | $152,500,000 | $153,500,000 | $153,000,000 | $154,000,000 | Includes interest from bridge loans and dividends from NexPoint preferred investment
General and administrative expenses | $188,500,000 | $189,500,000 | $188,000,000 | $189,500,000 | Includes non-cash compensation

FFO estimates for the year are fully diluted for an estimated average number of shares and OP units outstanding during the year. The Company’s estimates are forward-looking and based on management’s view of current and future market conditions. The Company’s actual results may differ materially from these estimates.
